title: Signing of Orders by District Commission

content.scenario: The District Commission has made an order in a case, and the President and the member who conducted the proceeding are considering how to finalize it.
content.outcome: The order made by the District Commission must be signed by the President and the member who conducted the proceeding, as per CPA2019-CH4-S39-4. If the order is made as per majority opinion, it must also be signed by the other member.

user_queries: Who signs the orders of the District Commission?
What happens if the order is made by majority opinion?
Can an order be finalized without the President's signature?
